diseases.name: Diabetic ketoacidosis / new type 1 diabetes
diseases.inv: Capillary and venous glucose, ketones, blood gas, electrolytes, urgent senior care.

diseases.name: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
diseases.inv: Fasting/random glucose, HbA1c per national criteria.

diseases.name: Diabetes insipidus
diseases.inv: Urine and serum osmolality, water deprivation test by specialist.

diseases.name: Hypercalcaemia / hyperparathyroidism
diseases.inv: Serum calcium, PTH, vitamin D, creatinine.

diseases.name: Hyperthyroidism (e.g. Graves disease)
diseases.inv: TSH, free T4/T3, TSH-receptor antibodies, thyroid scan if indicated.

diseases.name: Hypothyroidism
diseases.inv: TSH, free T4, anti-TPO antibodies.

diseases.name: Thyroid nodule / cancer
diseases.inv: Thyroid ultrasound, FNAC, TSH.

diseases.name: Subacute thyroiditis
diseases.inv: ESR, TSH, free T4; thyroid uptake if needed.
diseases.alt: Thyroid abscess, Graves disease, thyroid cancer

diseases.name: Cushing syndrome
diseases.inv: Exclude exogenous steroids; late-night salivary cortisol or dexamethasone suppression test through specialist.

diseases.name: Adrenal insufficiency
diseases.inv: Morning cortisol, short synacthen test, electrolytes, glucose; urgent treatment if unwell.

diseases.name: Familial short stature
diseases.inv: Growth chart and mid-parental height.
diseases.alt: Constitutional delay, endocrine disease, chronic illness

diseases.name: Hormone deficiency (e.g. growth hormone or thyroid)
diseases.inv: Bone age, TSH/free T4, IGF-1 and specialist testing.

diseases.name: Chronic illness / malnutrition
diseases.inv: CBC, celiac and renal screen, nutritional assessment as indicated.

diseases.name: Constitutional delay of growth and puberty
diseases.inv: Clinical, bone age; exclude hypogonadism.

diseases.name: Hyperprolactinaemia (drug-induced or prolactinoma)
diseases.inv: Serum prolactin, pregnancy test, TSH; pituitary MRI if indicated.

diseases.name: Erectile dysfunction: vascular / neuropathic
diseases.inv: Glucose, lipids, BP; testosterone if indicated.

diseases.name: Erectile dysfunction: psychogenic
diseases.inv: Clinical.

diseases.name: Male hypogonadism
diseases.inv: Morning testosterone, LH/FSH, prolactin.

diseases.name: Osteomalacia / vitamin D deficiency
diseases.inv: Vitamin D, calcium, phosphate, ALP, PTH, X-ray.

diseases.name: Bone metastasis or myeloma
diseases.inv: X-ray, bone scan, CBC, calcium, protein electrophoresis.

diseases.name: Thrombocytopenia (e.g. ITP, dengue, marrow failure)
diseases.inv: CBC with platelet count, peripheral smear; urgent review if very low.
diseases.alt: Leukaemia, dengue, liver disease, drug effect

diseases.name: Clotting factor disorder (e.g. haemophilia, von Willebrand)
diseases.inv: PT, aPTT, factor assays.

diseases.name: Acquired clotting problem (liver disease or drugs)
diseases.inv: PT/INR, LFTs, drug review.

flags.text: Vomiting, abdominal pain, deep fast breathing or drowsiness with thirst/weight loss: possible DKA, emergency
Adrenal insufficiency features with vomiting or low BP: possible adrenal crisis, urgent assessment
